## Changes since 9.3.0-dzbarsky29

- [PR #39](https://github.com/dzbarsky/bazel/pull/39): Distribute disk-cache temporary files across 16 directories to reduce contention between concurrent writers. Directories are created only when writing; final cache locations, fsync, atomic publication, and garbage collection are unchanged.
- [PR #40](https://github.com/dzbarsky/bazel/pull/40): Cache the native thread ID in the Starlark profiler's JNI getter to avoid repeated system calls during thread registration. The signal handler continues to use the uncached getter.
- [PR #41](https://github.com/dzbarsky/bazel/pull/41): Batch map-backed filesystem dirtiness checks in groups of 64 to reduce executor task allocation and queue traffic. Interruptible graph fetches remain individual tasks. On cancellation, each active map batch may finish up to 63 additional synchronous checks; this is a check-count bound, not a wall-time bound.

### Validation

Passed the disk-cache tests, `RemoteTests`, `FilesystemValueCheckerTest`, and all eight shards of `loading_phase_tests` (including Starlark CPU profiling) on Linux remote execution. All 21 immutable-release publication checks passed.

### Release publication

Linux and macOS binaries for x86_64 and arm64 are built and version-checked before publication. The immutable release includes SHA-256 checksums and build-provenance attestations.
